subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312's generic contract that non-default `channels.<kind>.accounts.<accountId>` changes restart only that account while default, global, mixed, secrets, and unlisted-account cases stay whole-channel?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the permanent fix changes compatibility-sensitive reload behavior for every account-capable channel plugin, which needs gateway owner intent before merge.

options.title: Approve the generic account-scoped contract
options.body: Land the current candidate after normal PR review and use whole-channel fallback only for default, global, mixed, secrets, and unresolved-account cases.

options.title: Require explicit plugin capability first
options.body: Keep whole-channel restart as the default and ask the PR to add a plugin-declared capability before account-scoped reloads apply broadly.

options.title: Reject account-scoped reloads for now
options.body: Keep the current whole-channel behavior and close the issue cluster as a deliberate compatibility tradeoff, documenting that operators must tolerate reload fanout.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic account-scoped contract
recommendation.body: Land the current candidate after normal PR review and use whole-channel fallback only for default, global, mixed, secrets, and unresolved-account cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway reload and channel helper history makes this the best available owner for the cross-plugin reload contract decision.
